title: Kenworth T900/T908/T909/T950 FUPS Compliant Custom Built Road Train High Tensile Aluminium Bullbar #66
description: Kenworth T900, T908, T909, T950 FUPS compliant polished Road Train hi-tensile aluminium Bullbar. Extended deep heavy duty reinforced main channel with extended box uprights to the base of the main channel plus Cow Catcher lower bar with three (3) small uprights for maximum protection. 76mm pipe and a full width cross pipe above headlights. All cross pipes are one piece and pass through the drilled uprights, no butt welds. The heavy duty box uprights are 6mm wall high tensile aluminium for maximum strength and protection. Flip over aluminium combination Road Train signs. Heavy duty high tensile aluminium backing plate with tow pin & Chrome tow protector plate. Main bumper channel with heavy duty return panel to match mudguard contour. The centre bar is a custom made extrusion that will mount a light bar. Optional 88mm or 100mm diameter tube is available on request.
